scientific_integrity: The cross-q conclusion is proved by reducing every algebra isomorphism to a published Witt Lie automorphism and then comparing the three affine coefficients in m and n. Finite computational checks are supplementary and are not used as a substitute for the infinite symbolic argument.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the complex graded Witt-compatible family with q nonzero and q not equal to 1. It does not cover the separate pre-Lie branch q=1, q=0, ungraded products, or arbitrary q-pre-Lie algebras. The motivating preprint is recent, so later revisions remain an originality risk.
title: The \(q\)-parameter is an isomorphism invariant for the graded Witt \(q\)-pre-Lie family
